To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the combination of arginine-restricted protein diet and ornithine supplements leads to a substantial and sustained reduction of the epileptogenic guanidino compound GAA in GAMT deficiency; (ii) the reduction of GAA is accompanied by a marked decrease of epileptogenic activities; and (iii) this is the first report of a successful treatment of GAMT deficiency by dietary means.
the dietary restriction of arginine and supplementation with ornithine led to a substantial reduction of guanidineacetate (GAC) in blood, urine and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).
arginine restriction and supplementation with ornithine can reduce the levels of GAA in body fluids of patients with GAMT deficiency.

improving treatment in GAMT deficiency by reducing GAA in body fluids by dietary means.
the identification of new therapeutic approaches to improve the treatment of GAMT deficiency.
